name: Burt's Bees Hand Repair Gift Set with Gloves
seoTitle: Hand Repair Cream Gift Set for Nurses
metaDescription: A Burt's Bees hand repair set with three creams and gloves, a soothing self care gift for nurses whose hands take a beating from constant hand washing.
summary: A comforting self care gift for hands that are washed and sanitized dozens of times a shift: three Burt's Bees creams plus gloves for an overnight treatment.
whyItWorks: Nurses wash and sanitize their hands more times in a single shift than most people do in a week. Add gloves on and off, dry hospital air, and cold weather walks from the parking garage, and cracked knuckles become part of the job. A hand care set is one of the most practical comfort gifts you can give a nurse, especially in winter.

The set includes three creams and a pair of gloves, which makes it feel like a small pampering kit rather than a single tube. Gloves let the recipient put on a thick layer of cream before bed and wake up with softer hands, a nice ritual after a run of long shifts. The cuticle cream is a thoughtful extra, since cuticles often split from frequent washing. Burt's Bees is a familiar, well known brand, so the gift feels safe for a coworker or a nurse you do not know well. Tuck it into a self care basket with fuzzy socks and a candle.
goodToKnow: Check the listing ingredients if the recipient has allergies, especially to nuts, since the title mentions almond milk.
Many nurses keep thick creams for home use and a lighter lotion for work, so this set suits evenings best.
Check the listing for the sizes of each cream if you are comparing gift sets.

faq.q: Can nurses use hand cream at work?
faq.a: Many do, though some facilities ask staff to use approved lotions that do not interfere with gloves or sanitizer. This set is a great fit for home and overnight care.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a male nurse?
faq.a: Yes, dry hands affect every nurse, and the set is practical rather than frilly. It works for anyone who washes their hands constantly at work.
